metadata.question: Did the volcanic plume from Mount Lewotobi Laki-Laki on the Indonesian island of Flores drift westward at about 2 pm local time on July 7, 2025?

data.raw_code: The user asks about a volcanic plume on July 7, 2025, which is in the future. Current Earth Engine data likely won't have images for that date. We need to: 1. Define the location: Mount Lewotobi Laki-Laki (approx -8.542, 122.775). 2. Set the date: July 7, 2025, around 2 pm local time (06:00 UTC ± 1 hour). 3. Try multiple satellite collections that could capture the plume at that time: - MODIS Aqua (MYD09GA) for ~13:30 local time - VIIRS (VNP09GA) for ~13:30 local time - MODIS Terra (MOD09GA) for ~10:30 local time (less likely) 4. Check if any collection has data. Since the date is in the future, all will likely be empty. 5. If empty, output C1 (Empty Collection). However, we should also consider: - We need to check image counts and valid pixels. - We might need to detect the plume direction, but without data, we can't. Given the future date, we expect no data. We'll try multiple collections and if all fail, output C1. Steps: 1. Define geometry (point and buffer). 2. Define time range: 2025-07-07T05:00:00 to 2025-07-07T07:00:00 UTC. 3. Try collections in order. 4. If any collection has an image, we would process it (but unlikely). 5. If no images in any collection, output C1. We'll structure the code to try each collection and print the count. If all are 0, output C1. Note: We must use the exact tag format for the answer. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const volcano = ee.Geometry.Point([122.775, -8.542]); // Mount Lewotobi Laki-Laki const region = volcano.buffer(50000); // 50 km buffer for analysis const date = '2025-07-07'; const startTime = ee.Date(date + 'T05:00:00'); // 05:00 UTC = 13:00 local const endTime = ee.Date(date + 'T07:00:00'); // 07:00 UTC = 15:00 local // Collections to try (ordered by relevance for afternoon overpass) const collections = [ { name: 'MODIS Aqua', id: 'MODIS/006/MYD09GA' }, { name: 'VIIRS', id: 'NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP09GA' }, { name: 'MODIS Terra', id: 'MODIS/006/MOD09GA' } ]; let image = null; let collectionName = ''; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check for (const col of collections) { const coll = ee.ImageCollection(col.id) .filterBounds(volcano) .filterDate(startTime, endTime) .select(['sur_refl_b01', 'sur_refl_b04', 'sur_refl_b03']); // RGB bands for MODIS/VIIRS const count = coll.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${col.name} Images: ${count}`); if (count > 0) { image = coll.first(); collectionName = col.name; break; } } if (!image) { console.log('No images found in any collection for the specified time and location.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing: Check valid pixels const redBand = image.select(0); // First band (sur_refl_b01 for MODIS, similar for VIIRS) const countResult = redBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const pixelCount = countResult.getInfo()[Object.keys(countResult.getInfo())[0]]; console.log(`Valid pixels in region: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Attempt plume detection and direction analysis // Simple threshold for bright pixels (potential plume) const threshold = 0.2; // Reflectance threshold const plumeMask = redBand.gt(threshold); // Get centroid of bright pixels const centroid = plumeMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.centroid(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); if (!centroid || Object.keys(centroid).length === 0) { console.log('Could not compute centroid (no bright pixels).'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Extract centroid coordinates (lon, lat) const centroidCoords = centroid[Object.keys(centroid)[0]]; const centroidLon = centroidCoords['coordinates'][0]; const volcanoLon = 122.775; console.log(`Volcano longitude: ${volcanoLon}`); console.log(`Plume centroid longitude: ${centroidLon}`); // 5. Determine if plume is westward const tolerance = 0.01; // Degrees if (centroidLon < volcanoLon - tolerance) { console.log('Plume centroid is west of volcano -> drifting westward.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Plume centroid is not west of volcano.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
